In the second Vishalandhra Mahasabha held at Hyderabad in 1954 who out of the following strongly supported vishalandhra
x:
The Second Visalandhra Mahasabha, held at Hyderabad in 1954, strongly advocated the merger of Andhra State and Telangana into a single Telugu-speaking state. Swami Ramananda Theertha, one of the foremost leaders of the Hyderabad State freedom movement, strongly supported the idea of Visalandhra. He believed that the unification of Telugu-speaking people would strengthen cultural unity and promote balanced regional development. His support played an important role in building public opinion in favour of the merger, which eventually led to the formation of Andhra Pradesh on 1 November 1956.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
